text: After exposing a scandal, the journalist Ji-won changes her number and moves into an empty house owned by her sister. When her little niece Young-ju [answers a call to the new phone and screams|trigger|an outsider reaches in], the girl turns strangely jealous of her mother and drawn to her father. Ji-won sees a long-haired ghost playing the "Moonlight Sonata" on the piano, and learns that the number belonged to [a missing teenager who loved an older man|threat|the restless dead], and that [its last two owners died mysteriously|rules|it passes to others].
